body: The screenshots are now in the description, under "What it looks like": before (no progress while `Contour1` generates) and after (the overlay at the top centre). They were rendered headless from the seeded shell at 1280x800. No snapshot PNG is in the branch, and no push was made.

This pull request now conflicts with `main`. Issue #2257 is a `P2` and holds the next release cut.

Please merge `main` into the branch and push. Do not rebase. Then comment "ready for a re-check".

Your claim on #2257 stays live for 48 hours after your last activity (2026-11-16 21:19 UTC). If the claim ends without a refresh, a maintainer agent will correct #2257 on a new branch and will credit your work. Thank you for the work so far.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (crates/ui/src/state.rs imports, crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs module list: keep both sides). Head: f04c549a. No rebase, no force-push.

- `tests.rs`: the module list keeps `generate_progress` from this branch and `frame_cost_caches` and `frame_cost_probe` from main.

Targeted gate on f04c549a:

- `egui_app::tests::generate_progress` (6) and `generate_staged` (2): green.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` at `--test-threads=16`: green in some runs. In other runs, `setup_post_options::the_post_page_radio_gives_the_setup_its_own_options` and `setup_settings_page::the_setup_page_is_laid_out_in_groups_like_the_wcs_page` fail. The two tests pass alone. A clean `upstream/main` worktree gives the same two failures in 1 of 4 runs. Thus the failures do not come from this PR.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Ready for a re-check.

Needs changes before merge.

Thank you for the worker split, the tests, the screenshots, and the merge from main. The manual merge keeps both intended import removals and all test modules.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/gen_worker.rs:86`: Resolve the operation label when the job starts, instead of during each repaint. `gen_overlay::paint` calls `gen_progress` for each active frame. `model::find_by_name` scans every `Name` component (`crates/app/src/model.rs:105`). Thus each 50 ms repaint adds a document-wide search, although the operation label did not change. Issue #2257 requires frame work that does not grow with the model. Store the label with the running job, or use a direct entity reference with a safe fallback. Update the stored label when its input changes. Add a counter test that proves repeated progress reads do not repeat the search.

Local results:

The trial merge with upstream/main `d3e779907018a9483902c6edc286cf9472712e3d` succeeded. All commands ran locally, one at a time. No GitHub runner was used.

The tests confirm that success, refusal, and Cancel remove the overlay. A refusal keeps its status message. An edited operation rejects the old result. The Cancel test confirms that a late result writes no history entry. The viewport input code excludes the overlay panel from new gestures. Input outside that panel remains available.

The generation algorithms, verification checks, stock simulation, geometry, and G-code rules are unchanged. The staged result uses the existing generation pipeline. No golden files changed. The edit, undo, delete, and Cancel cases passed; no source mutation experiment was supplied by this PR or performed during this review.

The body contains before/after screenshots. No snapshot PNG changed. I did not run a native window or the browser build. No contributor code was changed. The draft state stays as the author set it. The PR merges cleanly; the conflicts state does not apply.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Review fix pushed. Head: 4ac78101. The PR stays a draft.

1. `crates/ui/src/gen_worker.rs`: the running job now stores its label (`Running { name, started, label, label_doc }`).
   - The label is resolved when the job starts (`refresh_gen_label`).
   - `poll_generation` resolves it again only when `doc_version` changes, for example after a rename or an undo.
   - `gen_progress` reads the stored label. It does no world search. Thus a repaint does no `find_by_name` scan.
   - I did not store the entity: the entity can be deleted while the job runs. The label falls back to the operation name, as before.
2. New counter test `repaints_reuse_the_label_and_a_rename_resolves_it_once`:
   - 10 frames and 100 `gen_progress` reads do 1 search.
   - A `RenameOperation` does 1 more search, and the overlay shows `Generating Outer wall - ...`.
   - With the `doc_version` check removed, the test fails (10 searches, 1 expected).
3. The decision record has a new entry for this choice.

Targeted gate on 4ac78101:

- `egui_app::tests::generate_progress` (7): green.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` at `--test-threads=16`: 1024 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `camcraft-app` did not change.

Ready for a re-check.

A second review fix is pushed. Head: 43b789ed. The PR stays a draft. This replaces the approach in my last comment.

Why: after a process sync, I read the #2238 frame-cost rule (`docs/decisions/2238-frame-cost-rule.md`). It does not permit a new cache key on `doc_version` alone. 4ac78101 used such a key. Thus I used the other option from the review: a direct entity reference with a safe fallback.

1. `crates/ui/src/gen_worker.rs`: the job finds its operation entity one time, when it starts. `gen_progress` reads the label from that entity. A frame does no world search, and there is no cache to become stale.
2. `crates/app/src/model.rs`: new `live_operation_label`. It checks `World::is_alive` before the read and gives `None` for a deleted entity. Then the overlay shows the operation name.
3. Tests:
   - `one_search_for_each_job_and_a_rename_shows_without_another`: 10 frames and 100 `gen_progress` reads do 1 search. A `RenameOperation` shows at once, with no new search.
   - `a_deleted_operation_shows_its_name_and_no_dead_entity_is_read`: after `DeleteOperation`, the overlay shows `Contour1`. Without the `is_alive` check, the test process stops (0xc0000409).
4. The decision record entry is updated. It names the dropped `doc_version` approach.

`model.rs` gets 7 lines. The file was 482 lines before this change. I put the helper next to `operation_label`, because the UI crate does no raw world call.

Targeted gate on 43b789ed:

- `egui_app::tests::generate_progress` (8): green.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` at `--test-threads=16`: 1025 passed, 0 failed.
- `generate_staged` (2): green.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Ready for a re-check.
